notes: The waw of s012 takes the connective *when* the ASV writes for it rather than going unrepresented (rule 14, whose connective list is read off the ASV).

s005 (לַ before the infinitive) is unrepresented because the finite recasting *did* writes no word for it (rules 40, 52); s009 בְּ and s010 עֵינֵי each hold an English word, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 splits them.
